description: Get facts for one or all virtual machines in a resource group.

parameters.name: ad_user
parameters.description: Active Directory username. Use when authenticating with an Active Directory user rather than service principal.

parameters.name: adfs_authority_url
parameters.description: Azure AD authority url. Use when authenticating with Username/password, and has your own ADFS authority.

parameters.name: api_profile
parameters.description: Selects an API profile to use when communicating with Azure services. Default value of latest is appropriate for public clouds; future values will allow use with Azure Stack. Default: "latest"

parameters.name: auth_source
parameters.description: Controls the source of the credentials to use for authentication. Can also be set via the ANSIBLE_AZURE_AUTH_SOURCE environment variable. When set to auto (the default) the precedence is module parameters -> env -> credential_file -> cli. When set to env, the credentials will be read from the environment variables When set to credential_file, it will read the profile from ~/.azure/credentials. When set to cli, the credentials will be sources from the Azure CLI profile. subscription_id or the environment variable AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID can be used to identify the subscription ID if more than one is present otherwise the default az cli subscription is used. When set to msi, the host machine must be an azure resource with an enabled MSI extension. subscription_id or the environment variable AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID can be used to identify the subscription ID if the resource is granted access to more than one subscription, otherwise the first subscription is chosen. The msi was added in Ansible 2.6. Choices: "auto" ← (default) "cli" "credential_file" "env" "msi"

parameters.name: cert_validation_mode
parameters.description: Controls the certificate validation behavior for Azure endpoints. By default, all modules will validate the server certificate, but when an HTTPS proxy is in use, or against Azure Stack, it may be necessary to disable this behavior by passing ignore. Can also be set via credential file profile or the AZURE_CERT_VALIDATION environment variable. Choices: "ignore" "validate"

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: Azure client ID. Use when authenticating with a Service Principal or Managed Identity (msi). Can also be set via the AZURE_CLIENT_ID environment variable.

parameters.name: cloud_environment
parameters.description: For cloud environments other than the US public cloud, the environment name (as defined by Azure Python SDK, eg, AzureChinaCloud, AzureUSGovernment), or a metadata discovery endpoint URL (required for Azure Stack). Can also be set via credential file profile or the AZURE_CLOUD_ENVIRONMENT environment variable. Default: "AzureCloud"

parameters.name: disable_instance_discovery
parameters.description: Determines whether or not instance discovery is performed when attempting to authenticate. Setting this to true will completely disable both instance discovery and authority validation. This functionality is intended for use in scenarios where the metadata endpoint cannot be reached such as in private clouds or Azure Stack. The process of instance discovery entails retrieving authority metadata from https://login.microsoft.com/ to validate the authority. By setting this to **True**, the validation of the authority is disabled. As a result, it is crucial to ensure that the configured authority host is valid and trustworthy. Set via credential file profile or the AZURE_DISABLE_INSTANCE_DISCOVERY environment variable. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: log_mode
parameters.description: Parent argument.

parameters.name: log_path
parameters.description: Parent argument.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the virtual machine.

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: Active Directory user password. Use when authenticating with an Active Directory user rather than service principal.

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: Security profile found in ~/.azure/credentials file.

parameters.name: resource_group
parameters.description: Name of the resource group containing the virtual machines (required when filtering by vm name).

parameters.name: secret
parameters.description: Azure client secret. Use when authenticating with a Service Principal.

parameters.name: subscription_id
parameters.description: Your Azure subscription Id.

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Limit results by providing a list of tags. Format tags as ‘key’ or ‘key:value’.

parameters.name: tenant
parameters.description: Azure tenant ID. Use when authenticating with a Service Principal.

parameters.name: thumbprint
parameters.description: The thumbprint of the private key specified in x509_certificate_path. Use when authenticating with a Service Principal. Required if x509_certificate_path is defined.

parameters.name: x509_certificate_path
parameters.description: Path to the X509 certificate used to create the service principal in PEM format. The certificate must be appended to the private key. Use when authenticating with a Service Principal.

examples:
- name: Get facts for all virtual machines of a resource group
  azure_rm_virtualmachine_info:
    resource_group: myResourceGroup

- name: Get facts by name
  azure_rm_virtualmachine_info:
    resource_group: myResourceGroup
    name: myVm

- name: Get facts by tags
  azure_rm_virtualmachine_info:
    resource_group: myResourceGroup
    tags:
      - testing
      - foo:bar

return_values.name: vms
return_values.description: List of virtual machines. Returned: always

return_values.name: additional_capabilities
return_values.description: Enables or disables a capability on the virtual machine. Returned: always Sample: {"ultra_ssd_enabled": false}

return_values.name: admin_username
return_values.description: Administrator user name. Returned: always Sample: "admin"

return_values.name: boot_diagnostics
return_values.description: Information about the boot diagnostics settings. Returned: always

return_values.name: console_screenshot_uri
return_values.description: Contains a URI to grab a console screenshot. Only present if enabled. Returned: always Sample: "https://mystorageaccountname.blob.core.windows.net/bootdiagnostics-myvm01-a4db09a6-ab7f-4d80-9da8-fbceaef9288a/ myVm.a4db09a6-ab7f-4d80-9da8-fbceaef9288a.screenshot.bmp"

return_values.name: enabled
return_values.description: Indicates if boot diagnostics are enabled. Returned: always Sample: true

return_values.name: serial_console_log_uri
return_values.description: Contains a URI to grab the serial console log. Only present if enabled. Returned: always Sample: "https://mystorageaccountname.blob.core.windows.net/bootdiagnostics-myvm01-a4db09a6-ab7f-4d80-9da8-fbceaef9288a/ myVm.a4db09a6-ab7f-4d80-9da8-fbceaef9288a.serialconsole.log"

return_values.name: storage_uri
return_values.description: Indicates the storage account used by boot diagnostics. Returned: always Sample: "https://mystorageaccountname.blob.core.windows.net/"

return_values.name: CapacityReservation
return_values.description: The name or ID of the capacity reservation group to be associated with. Returned: always Sample: {}

return_values.name: data_disks
return_values.description: List of attached data disks. Returned: always

return_values.name: caching
return_values.description: Type of data disk caching. Returned: always Sample: "ReadOnly"

return_values.name: disk_size_gb
return_values.description: The initial disk size in GB for blank data disks. Returned: always Sample: 64

return_values.name: lun
return_values.description: The logical unit number for data disk. Returned: always Sample: 0

return_values.name: managed_disk_id
return_values.description: Managed data disk ID. Returned: always Sample: "/subscriptions/xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx/resourceGroups/myResourceGroup/Microsoft.Compute/disks/diskName"

return_values.name: managed_disk_type
return_values.description: Managed data disk type. Returned: always Sample: "Standard_LRS"

return_values.name: write_accelerator_enabled
return_values.description: Specifies whether writeAccelerator should be enabled or disabled on the disk. Returned: always Sample: false

return_values.name: display_status
return_values.description: The short localizable label for the status. Returned: always Sample: "VM running"

return_values.name: id
return_values.description: Resource ID. Returned: always Sample: "/subscriptions/xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx/resourceGroups/myResourceGroup/providers/Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachines/myVm"

return_values.name: identity
return_values.description: The identity of the virtual machine. Returned: always Sample: {"principal_id": "xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx", "tenant_id": "xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx", "type": "SystemAssigned, UserAssigned", "user_assigned_identities": {"/subscriptions/xxx/resourceGroups/testRG/providers/Microsoft.ManagedIdentity/userAssignedIdentities/test": {"client_id": "xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx", "principal_id": "xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx"}}}

return_values.name: image
return_values.description: Image specification. Returned: always

return_values.name: community_gallery_image_id
return_values.description: The community gallery image unique id for vm deployment. Returned: when created from community gallery image Sample: "/CommunityGalleries/yellowbrick-fc7e81f1-87dd-4989-9ca8-03743762e873/Images/Ubuntu-5.15.0-1035-azure_22.04"

return_values.name: offer
return_values.description: The offer of the platform image or marketplace image used to create the virtual machine. Returned: when created from marketplace image Sample: "RHEL"

return_values.name: publisher
return_values.description: Publisher name. Returned: when created from marketplace image Sample: "RedHat"

return_values.name: sku
return_values.description: SKU name. Returned: when created from marketplace image Sample: "7-RAW"

return_values.name: version
return_values.description: Image version. Returned: when created from marketplace image Sample: "7.5.2018050901"

return_values.name: location
return_values.description: Resource location. Returned: always Sample: "japaneast"

return_values.name: maintenance_redeploy_status
return_values.description: If maintenance is scheduled for this server set to something like example, otherwise empty dict Returned: always Sample: {"is_customer_initiated_maintenance_allowed": true, "last_operation_result_code": "None", "maintenance_window_end_time": "2025-06-18T23:59:00.000Z", "maintenance_window_start_time": "2025-06-12T00:00:00.000Z", "pre_maintenance_window_end_time": "2025-06-11T23:30:00.000Z", "pre_maintenance_window_start_time": "2025-01-30T00:00:00.000Z"}

return_values.name: name
return_values.description: Resource name. Returned: always Sample: "myVm"

return_values.name: network_interface_names
return_values.description: List of attached network interfaces. Returned: always Sample: ["myNetworkInterface"]

return_values.name: os_disk_caching
return_values.description: Type of OS disk caching. Returned: always Sample: "ReadOnly"

return_values.name: os_type
return_values.description: Base type of operating system. Returned: always Sample: "Linux"

return_values.name: power_state
return_values.description: Power state of the virtual machine. Returned: always Sample: "running"

return_values.name: provisioning_state
return_values.description: The provisioning state, which only appears in the response. Returned: always Sample: "running"

return_values.name: proximityPlacementGroup
return_values.description: The name or ID of the proximity placement group the VM should be associated with. Returned: always Sample: {"id": "/subscriptions/xxx/resourceGroups/xxx/providers/Microsoft.Compute/proximityPlacementGroups/testid13"}

return_values.name: resource_group
return_values.description: Resource group. Returned: always Sample: "myResourceGroup"

return_values.name: security_profile
return_values.description: Specifies the Security related profile settings for the virtual machine. Returned: when-used

return_values.name: encryption_at_host
return_values.description: This property can be used by user in the request to enable or disable the Host Encryption for the virtual machine. This will enable the encryption for all the disks including Resource/Temp disk at host itself. Returned: when-enabled Sample: true

return_values.name: security_type
return_values.description: Specifies the SecurityType of the virtual machine. It is set as TrustedLaunch to enable UefiSettings. Returned: when-enabled Sample: "TrustedLaunch"

return_values.name: uefi_settings
return_values.description: Specifies the security settings like secure boot and vTPM used while creating the virtual machine. Returned: when-enabled

return_values.name: secure_boot_enabled
return_values.description: Specifies whether secure boot should be enabled on the virtual machine. Returned: when-enabled Sample: true

return_values.name: v_tpm_enabled
return_values.description: Specifies whether vTPM should be enabled on the virtual machine. Returned: when-enabled Sample: true

return_values.name: state
return_values.description: State of the resource. Returned: always Sample: "present"

return_values.name: tags
return_values.description: Resource tags. Returned: always Sample: {"key1": "value1"}

return_values.name: user_data
return_values.description: UserData for the VM, which must be base-64 encoded. Returned: always Sample: "None"

return_values.name: vm_agent_version
return_values.description: Version of the Azure VM Agent (waagent) running inside the VM. Returned: always Sample: "2.9.1.1"

return_values.name: vm_size
return_values.description: Virtual machine size. Returned: always Sample: "Standard_D4"

return_values.name: zones
return_values.description: A list of Availability Zones for your VM. Returned: success Sample: [1]
